bottom_line: The ratings are not broken, but tonight is a poor time to start them: Nasdaq-100 futures are down roughly 1-1.5% after a 2% fall on Thursday, and Asia sold chips hard overnight. Most names are flat to down since rating, so there is no chasing risk, but the worldview's 'VIX near 30 forces de-leveraging' risk is live; let the open settle first.
what_changed: Nasdaq-100 futures -1.1% to -1.5% and S&P futures -0.4% to -0.6% pre-market; Anthropic's IPO failed to lift sentiment (crowded-AI-trade thesis, VIX risk).
Kospi -4.3% and Nikkei -4% overnight; Taiwan heading for its worst week since 1990 on the chip sell-off.
Hunterbrook short report on AMD's chip financing: AMD -7.7% Thursday and -2.3% after hours (export/financing risk widening beyond Nvidia, a named risk).
Keysight beat (revenue +41%) is the one AI-supplier positive; Intuit -10% after hours weighs on software.

trust: Only 6 ratings are graded so far. New picks average -4.5% vs QQQ, about the same as the equal-weight universe (-4.4%) and a random shortlist pick (-3.8%); the Buy/Overweight subset (-1.3%) is better, but the sample is too small to lean on.
if_buying: Overweight means a small starter only; tonight, half of that.
